ashley_cs: Quick heads up — I found a cluster of accounts that finished onboarding but are still scoring as 'at-risk' by healthscore. Example: AC-1123 shows high product setup but health_score=28.
rahul_data: Can you paste a couple examples + the raw fields? Might be a weighting or a null-handling issue after the event schema change last week.
ashley_cs: Pasting a quick export (sanitized):
```
account_id, onboarding_complete, usage_events, last_active_days, health_score
AC-1123, true, , 3, 28
AC-1199, true, 0, 7, 31
AC-1201, true, 1, 20, 45
```
Note the blank in usage_events for AC-1123.
rahul_data: That blank looks like null ingestion. I suspect the new event pipeline renamed `action` -> `event_type` and our join uses the old key. I'll run a quick query to check null rates. SQL snippet to reproduce: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, count(*) as events, sum(case when event_type is null then 1 else 0 end) as null_event_type
FROM analytics.raw_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY events DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
I'll run for the affected cohort and share counts.
emily_eng: Heads up — our playbook automation (renewal-outreach) fires when health_score < 40. That's why CS owners got outreach nudges for AC-1123. Two ideas: (1) quick patch to the playbook to require last_active_days > 14 OR (2) run an enrichment job to backfill usage_events before changing automation. Option 1 avoids noisy nudges but might hide real risk.
ashley_cs: I prefer 1 short-term (safest) + 2 mid-term. We should also surface a per-owner impact list so they can triage.
sam_ops: I can run a 48h dry-run where we simulate the automation with the proposed extra gate (last_active_days > 14) and produce a CSV of would-have-fired accounts vs actual fired accounts. Assign to me if approved.
nora_pm: +1 to dry-run. Can you also add a quick column: owner_email and onboarding_bucket? PMs want context for outreach messaging.
rahul_data: On the ingestion side, preliminary check shows ~2.6% of events in the last 7 days have null event_type from legacy SDKs. Patch candidate: map legacy `action` into `event_type` during ingestion, then re-run aggregation. Backfill complexity depends on retention window (we keep raw for 30 days). I'll prepare a migration plan.
emily_eng: Migration plan and dry-run are fine. For the playbook change, let's add a canary: only apply gate for accounts with health_score between 25 and 40 to limit side effects.
ashley_cs: Action items: 
- @rahul_data: prepare list of impacted accounts + estimate how many will be fixed by backfill (due EOD)
- @sam_ops: run 48h dry-run with gating logic and include owner_email + onboarding_bucket (start tomorrow AM)
- @emily_eng: prepare a one-line playbook patch and rollback plan for canary
- @nora_pm: notify CS leads that we're doing a dry-run and expect fewer false-positive nudges this week
rahul_data: Will share sample list in this thread. Quick sample query I ran returned ~420 accounts with null usage_events and health_score < 40 in the last 30 days.
ashley_cs: Perfect. For transparency, I'll message CS leads with two examples and the proposed mitigation. Also tagging product so they can adjust messaging if needed.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for ingestion hotfix branch (ingest-map-legacy-action) — build passed, tests 82/83, one flaky test (metrics.test_event_counts) marked flaky.
sam_ops: Noted. I'll coordinate with infra to run the dry-run on the staging snapshot and produce the CSV by EOD+1.
ashley_cs: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: rahul to post impacted account CSV, sam to post dry-run results, emily to open the playbook PR with canary flags. We'll reconvene Friday at 10am to decide rollout.
